result.summary: Found 3 issues: a critical data rendering bug showing an invalid delivery price, plus two minor layout/content issues.

issues.description: The delivery fee for 'Smash Bros Burgers' displays as '€NaN' (Not a Number), indicating a broken data/formatting value.
issues.suggestion: Fix the delivery price calculation or fallback to a formatted currency value, e.g., '€0.00' or 'Free delivery', and add a default for missing/invalid numeric data.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Picco' in the 'Fastest near you' section appears truncated, likely missing the last word(s).
issues.suggestion: Allow the card width to accommodate the full name, truncate with an ellipsis, or use a smaller font size for long names.

issues.description: The bottom pizza restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section is partially cut off at the bottom edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or margin so the last card is fully visible above the bottom navigation bar and home indicator.
